mentions.name: SNES cloud save sync bridge
mentions.description: This project syncs game saves via the cloud between a real Super Nintendo console and emulators. A microcontroller wired to the SNES's spare controller port acts as a WiFi bridge, and a flash cart runs a small save sync routine (patched into the reset vector) that talks to the microcontroller. Firmware tweaks were developed iteratively with Claude reading logic analyser output.
mentions.source_excerpt: Cloud save sync between a real Super Nintendo and emulators.
mentions.author: dannyboland
